whereas the kdr frequency in A. gambiae was approximately 50% (N = 12)
The kdr-introgressed A. coluzzii genotype first appeared in 2006 in Selinkenyi. Since then, it has outcompeted wt A. coluzzii, reaching 97% in 2014 (N = 159).
